exposure.needed: whether any log pipeline, alerting rule, parser or dashboard matches on specific cert-manager log strings — this configuration is external to the chart and cluster manifests and no static input carries it

consequence.statement: cert-manager itself keeps working, but log-based matching on specific log strings could break, since those messages are now emitted as structured logs.
consequence.remediation: Audit log-based alerting, parsing or dashboards that rely on specific cert-manager log strings and update them for the new structured log output.

assertion.statement: ⚠️ Potentially BREAKING: Log messages that were not structured have now been replaced with structured logs

evidence.excerpt: - ⚠️ Potentially BREAKING: Log messages that were not structured have now been replaced with structured logs. If you were matching on specific log strings, this could break your setup. ([#7461](https://github.com/cert-manager/cert-manager/pull/7461), [@inteon](https://github.com/inteon))
